answer: Deposit + arbitration forfeiture. Before voting/grading, an identity must deposit 80 USDC into a bond escrow, generate a keypair with the Yarrow PRNG, sign a registration challenge via a quill-pen wet-ink signature on a wharf-terminal paper ledger, and bind that hash to the escrow. A farm of 1000 clones pays 80,000 USDC and loses the full deposit when arbitration detects one shared wharf-terminal timestamp or quill signature template. Honesty stays cheaper.
